The power set of $X,$ denoted $P(X),$ is the set that contains every possible subset of $X,$ including the empty set $∅.$

So, let's list all possible subsets of $X$ using a tree diagram.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14095809/assets/04cf4a4f2113771f5aa5f948f1c460e1c4611dd1d0448dea50bbb5a8ecb32739.png)

According to our diagram, the subsets of $X$ are

$$
∅={},\,{\sqrt{5}},\,{\sqrt{7}},\,{\sqrt{5},\sqrt{7}}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
P(X)={∅,{\sqrt{5}},{\sqrt{7}},{\sqrt{5},\sqrt{7}}}.
$$
